purpose: Ground truth for measuring jevitate verdict quality on the seeded-defect lab. Each variant changes exactly one behavior of the clean app.

J1.goal: Change the profile name to 'Ada Byron' and the email to 'ada.byron@example.com', press Save, then reload the page and confirm the new values persisted.

J2.goal: Send a message 'Hello from Acme' to the first contact and confirm it appears in the Sent messages list.

J3.goal: Import the pasted CSV of contacts (name,email), map the columns, complete every confirmation, and confirm the imported rows appear.

defectClasses.none: No defect: the job completes and nothing is misreported.
defectClasses.failed-submit-masked: A write fails at the network layer while the UI reports success.
defectClasses.stall-no-request: A primary control produces no request and no feedback.
defectClasses.excess-effort: A functional job that adds avoidable confirmation work; no error.
defectClasses.dead-end: A primary control is disabled with no explanation, so the job cannot complete.

goal.defectExpected: true when a goal-strategy run should report the variant as a defect (a failed/dead-end goal or a stall), false when it should report success
goal.expectedOutcome: the goal outcome a correct run should reach: succeeded | failed | blocked | exhausted

usability.defectExpected: true when a usability review should surface a finding for the variant
usability.effortElevated: true when the variant adds avoidable steps and a review should report higher effort
usability.note: usability findings are advisory; they never gate missionOutcome

clean.description: Every job behaves: J1 persists, J2 sends and shows the message, J3 imports after its normal steps.

j1-5xx.description: The profile Save issues PUT /api/profile, which returns 500 and does not persist, yet the page shows the 'Saved' status regardless.

goal.note: Reloading after Save exposes the unchanged value behind the false 'Saved'.

usability.note: The usability run correctly reports the failed backend save: the 500 surfaces through the backend signal, so it is a true detection.

j2-stall.description: The Send button submits nothing: no request leaves the browser and no status text or sent row appears.

goal.note: The goal cannot complete and the run should report the dead control.

usability.note: A primary control that does nothing is a clear usability defect.

j3-effort.description: The import inserts three extra confirmation screens between column mapping and the final Import; each needs a click and none errors.

goal.note: The import still completes; only its effort is inflated.

usability.note: A correct review reports elevated effort without a functional defect.

j3-deadend.description: The final Import button is disabled and no explanation is offered, so the import cannot be completed.

goal.note: The run reaches the confirm screen but cannot finish the goal.

usability.note: A disabled primary action with no explanation is a clear usability defect.
